dataset.title: Autonomous Greenhouse Challenge, First Edition (2018)
dataset.experiment_description: Four-month cucumber production in six glasshouse compartments (the WUR description states 96 m2; it does not clarify in the page text whether this is per compartment or total area).

local_copy.download_date_note: Fill in the actual date the local copy was downloaded; do not use the dataset publication date.
local_copy.preservation: Original downloaded files should remain unmodified.

license.name: CC0 1.0 Universal (CC0 1.0) Public Domain Dedication
license.usage_conditions: The dataset is dedicated to the public domain under CC0 1.0.
license.notes: The dataset-specific 4TU.ResearchData deposit explicitly identifies CC0 1.0 as its license. Academic citation of the original dataset is still recommended.

citation: Hemming, S., de Zwart, H. F., Elings, A., Righini, I., & Petropoulou, A. (2019). Autonomous Greenhouse Challenge, First Edition (2018). Wageningen University & Research. https://doi.org/10.4121/uuid:e4987a7b-04dd-4c89-9b18-883aad30ba9a

integrity.checksum_scope: All regular files recursively under data/raw/wur/
integrity.note: Generate the manifest locally after confirming the raw dataset is complete.

audit_notes: The six local directories are team-labelled folders. Their mapping to physical compartment IDs has not yet been independently established.
The local team directory Reference(Growers) corresponds to the publisher-described Reference compartment/team; retain the original folder name.
Production.csv contains candidate production variables, but variable definitions and units must be checked against ReadMe.pdf before assigning a forecasting target.
